headings: 2. Restart your AI tool, then test
readme.excerpt: Agent-agnostic token optimization: compress, route, filter, and more. One composable pipeline across everything your AI agent reads and sends — built on RTK's battle-tested bash-output compression (up to 90% smaller). Website • Install • Troubleshooting • Architecture • Discord English • Francais • 中文 • 日本語 • 한국어 • Espanol • Português --- rtk filters and compresses command outputs before they reach your LLM context. Single Rust binary, 100+ supported commands, Full explanation: How RTK Savings Work Installation Then check you have the right package — another project named "rtk" exists on crates.io: Cargo, pre-built binaries, native Windows, WSL, and uninstall: Installation guide What You Install RTK ships as three downloads. The two `rtk` editions install a binary with the same name — hooks, scripts and agent config work unchanged across both — so they cannot be installed together. Uninstall one before installing the other. Download Licence Contains --- --- --- `rtk- ` Apache-2.0 + BUSL-1.1 Hook core, every command filter, and the compression engine `rtk-oss- ` Apache-2.0 only Hook core and every command filter. No engine. `rtk-proxy- ` BUSL-1.1 The RTK Proxy daemon. Never bundled with either `rtk`. Production use is free , engine and daemon included.
